definitions.explanation: A formal written work presenting research, arguments, or analysis on a particular subject, especially for academic purposes.

examples.japanese: {卒業|そつぎょう}{論文|ろんぶん}を{書|か}いている。
{論文|ろんぶん}を{学会|がっかい}で{発表|はっぴょう}した。
examples.english: I presented my paper at an academic conference.

examples.japanese: この{論文|ろんぶん}は{学術|がくじゅつ}{雑誌|ざっし}に{掲載|けいさい}された。
examples.english: This paper was published in an academic journal.

notes:
USAGE: {論文|ろんぶん} specifically refers to academic or scholarly papers, theses, and dissertations.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{論文|ろんぶん}を{書|か}く (to write a paper)
・{論文|ろんぶん}を{発表|はっぴょう}する (to present a paper)
・{卒業|そつぎょう}{論文|ろんぶん} (graduation thesis)
・{修士|しゅうし}{論文|ろんぶん} (master's thesis)
・{博士|はくし}{論文|ろんぶん} (doctoral dissertation)
・{学術|がくじゅつ}{論文|ろんぶん} (academic paper)

CONTRAST:
・{論文|ろんぶん} - academic paper, formal research
・{作文|さくぶん} - essay, composition (school level)
・{記事|きじ} - article (journalism)
